decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to maintain a fast-paced offensive strategy. By deploying a mix of aggressive creatures such as Raffine, Scheming Seer and Dennick, Pious Apprentice, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain board control. The inclusion of cards like Faerie Mastermind and Deep-Cavern Bat adds versatility to the deck, allowing for different lines of attack. With a balanced mana base and key utility lands, this deck aims to consistently apply pressure and secure victories through efficient play.

This deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent with cards like Duress and Negate, while also removing threats with cards like Deadly Cover-Up and Go for the Throat. It focuses on card advantage with Memory Deluge and recycling resources with Deadly Cover-Up. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal to close out the game. The mana base is designed to ensure smooth mana curve and consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck is built to outlast and outwit the opponent through control and resource management.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by quickly deploying creatures and overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and combat tricks. The deck includes low-cost creatures to establish early board presence, as well as cards that provide additional value and tempo advantage. The mana base allows for smooth casting of spells and ensures that the deck can consistently curve out and apply pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive attacking and efficient use of resources.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using a mix of creatures, removal spells, and enchantments to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing efficient creatures like Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Raffine, Scheming Seer, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while also dealing damage. Wedding Announcement and Virtue of Loyalty provide additional buffs for the creatures, allowing for powerful attacks. The land base includes a mix of dual lands to ensure consistent mana production for the aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing an aggressive playstyle with a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The main strategy revolves around efficiently removing threats with cards like Cut Down and Go for the Throat, while establishing a board presence with creatures like Tinybones, the Pickpocket and Slogurk, the Overslime. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide access to powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Plaza of Heroes to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful abilities and synergy to overwhelm your opponent quickly. By combining evasive creatures like Faerie Mastermind with removal spells and disruption like Go for the Throat and No More Lies, you can control the board and push through damage efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal and The Wandering Emperor adds a strategic element to the deck, giving you options to disrupt your opponent's game plan and gain an advantage. With a mix of aggression and control, this Esper Aggro deck aims to outmaneuver and outpace the opponent for a swift victory.

This Esper Aggro deck focuses on using a combination of creatures with disruptive abilities and removal spells to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total. Cards like Duelist of the Mind, Faerie Mastermind, and Lord Skitter, Sewer King provide utility and synergy with spells like No More Lies and Get Lost to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes a mix of efficient removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to clear the way for aggressive creatures like Deep-Cavern Bat and Raffine, Scheming Seer to deal damage and secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using aggressive red creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to have a fast and explosive start, overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Cards like Bloodthirsty Adversary, Monastery Swiftspear, and Urabrask's Forge help to apply pressure early on, while burn spells like Lightning Strike, Play with Fire, and Obliterating Bolt finish off the opponent or clear the way for attacks. The deck also includes a few creatures with abilities to further enhance the aggression.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creature removal and protection. It includes a variety of powerful legendary creatures such as Titania, Ertai Resurrected, and Vial Smasher, along with supportive cards like Relic of Legends and Honest Rutstein. The mana base is well-balanced with a mix of lands that provide various colors of mana, ensuring a smooth curve of spells. The deck aims to quickly build up a strong board presence and pressuring the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and removal spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures and combat tricks. The deck includes cards that provide a low mana curve to ensure a fast start, as well as cards that can generate tokens to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of multiple removal spells helps to clear the opponent's board and allow for uncontested attacks. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive strategy by providing consistent access to both colors of mana needed for the deck's cards.

The deck focuses on aggressive early game creatures like Novice Inspector and Knight-Errant of Eos to quickly build a board presence. It also includes removal spells like Gleeful Demolition to control the board and push through damage. Resolute Reinforcements and Warleader's Call provide additional creature tokens for added pressure. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and direct damage spells, utilizing cards like Case of the Gateway Express and Voldaren Epicure to close out games quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells and creatures.

This Esper Aggro deck focuses on using Faerie Mastermind and Raffine, Scheming Seer to quickly assemble a board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to control the board. Virtue of Loyalty and Wedding Announcement help to buff your creatures and keep the pressure on your opponent. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, using its various tools to outpace and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to react.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption spells to control the pace of the game and put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing powerful cards like Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Wedding Announcement, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and maintain control of the battlefield. The inclusion of Faerie Mastermind and Raffine, Scheming Seer adds additional synergy and card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent. Ultimately, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing creatures with abilities that can control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to quickly build a presence on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature damage and removal spells. The inclusion of Faerie Mastermind and Preacher of the Schism allows for strategic manipulation of the opponent's resources, giving the deck an edge in tempo and maintaining board control. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this deck aims to control the game and secure a victory through relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies involving the manipulation of spells and creatures to gain an advantage over the opponent. It combines elements of control and aggression to disrupt the opponent's plans while steadily building up its own board presence. Key cards include Rona, Herald of Invasion and Conspiracy Unraveler, which help to control the battlefield and provide additional resources. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Jace, the Perfected Mind to further control the game and seal the victory.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal while drawing cards and generating card advantage. It focuses on controlling the board and out-valuing the opponent by constantly denying their resources and consistently hitting land drops. Using a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant position and win through attrition. It also leverages powerful planeswalkers and powerful finishers to secure victory once the opponent's resources have been depleted.
